questions.q: You know it well / that your success in life / depends not on my advice / but on somebody else.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: The possessive is needed with 'somebody else': 'on somebody else's (advice)'.
questions.sectionDirections: Each item has a sentence divided into parts labelled (a), (b), (c)... Identify the part containing an error; if there is no error choose 'No error'.

questions.q: He informed me / that he had gone to / one of the Minister's residences / and stayed there all night.
questions.subject: English
questions.explanation: 'One of the Minister's residences' is acceptable: several residences of a single minister.

questions.q: The building's roof / needs repairing otherwise / it may fall down and / result into many persons' death.

questions.q: I visited / John's and Mary's house / twice but / found the couple absent.
